title: Entity Representation Learning Through Onsite-Offsite Graph for Pinterest Ads
abstract: arXiv:2508.02609v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNN) have been extensively applied to industry recommendation systems, as seen in models like GraphSage\cite{GraphSage}, TwHIM\cite{TwHIM}, LiGNN\cite{LiGNN} etc. In these works, graphs were constructed based on users' activities on the platforms, and various graph models were developed to effectively learn node embeddings. In addition to users' onsite activities, their offsite conversions are crucial for Ads models to capture their shopping interest. To better leverage offsite conversion data and explore the connection between onsite and offsite activities, we constructed a large-scale heterogeneous graph based on users' onsite ad interactions and opt-in offsite conversion activities. translated_title: 基于现场-场外图进行实体表示学习以应用于Pinterest广告
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.02609v3 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：图神经网络（GNN）已广泛应用于工业推荐系统，如GraphSage、TwHIM、LiGNN等模型所示。在这些工作中，图是基于用户在平台上的活动构建的，并开发了各种图模型来有效学习节点嵌入。除了用户的现场活动外，他们的场外转化对于广告模型捕捉购物兴趣至关重要。为了更好地利用场外转化数据并探索现场与场外活动之间的联系，我们基于用户的现场广告互动和选择加入的场外转化活动构建了一个大规模异构图。此外，我们引入了TransRA（带锚点的TransR），一种新颖的知识图谱嵌入（KGE）模型，以更高效地将图嵌入集成到广告排序模型中。然而，我们的广告排序模型...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于用户现场和场外活动的大规模异构图构建方法，并引入了带锚点的TransR模型（TransRA）来高效集成图嵌入，从而提升Pinterest广告排序模型的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a large-scale heterogeneous graph construction method based on users' onsite and offsite activities, and introduces TransRA (TransR with Anchors) to efficiently integrate graph embeddings, thereby improving Pinterest ads ranking model performance.
